leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a CSRF token generation endpoint in a Node.js server
Configure middleware to validate CSRF tokens on protected routes
Integrate CSRF token injection into HTML form responses
Construct client-side JavaScript to extract and attach CSRF tokens to AJAX requests
Apply CSRF protection to both form submissions and API endpoints
Manipulate server responses to include CSRF tokens in appropriate headers
Implement error handling for invalid or missing CSRF tokens
lessonTitle: Build CSRF protection flow for web clients
